evals.name: strategy-selection-undecided
evals.prompt: I have a Grasshopper model on ShapeDiver and I want to build a web configurator for my furniture product. I'm not sure which approach to use.
evals.expected_output: A clear explanation of the available integration strategies (App Builder, Viewer API, Platform Backend, Geometry Backend, and combined Platform+Geometry workflows) with guidance to help the user choose.
assertions: Presents at least three relevant integration options including App Builder and Viewer 3 API, plus the appropriate backend path.
Explains when to use Platform Backend, Geometry Backend, or the combined PB+GB workflow for backend tasks.
Asks clarifying questions to determine the user's needs before recommending a specific path
Does NOT immediately start writing code without choosing a strategy first

evals.name: route-to-iframe
evals.prompt: I want to embed my ShapeDiver model on my WordPress site with minimal effort. No custom code needed.
evals.expected_output: Routes the user to the iframe/App Builder strategy and collects the model slug.
assertions: Recommends the iframe or App Builder approach (not Viewer API)
Asks for the model slug or App Builder URL
Does NOT ask for ticket or modelViewUrl (not needed for iframe embedding)
Mentions reading the shapediver-appbuilder or shapediver-appbuilder-iframe skill

evals.name: route-to-viewer-api
evals.prompt: I need to build a fully custom 3D configurator with drag-and-drop interactions, custom materials, and a completely custom React UI using my ShapeDiver model.
evals.expected_output: Routes the user to the Viewer 3 API path and collects the necessary credentials.
assertions: Recommends the Viewer 3 API approach (not App Builder)
Asks for ticket and modelViewUrl, or offers the API script as an alternative
Mentions reading the shapediver-viewer skill before writing code
Does NOT start writing Viewer API code without first collecting credentials

evals.name: route-to-platform-backend
evals.prompt: I need to authenticate to the ShapeDiver Platform Backend and add a new embedding domain for one of my models.
evals.expected_output: Routes the user to the Platform Backend path, not to Viewer, App Builder, or Geometry runtime.
assertions: Classifies the task as Platform Backend work.
Requests Platform auth context rather than backend ticket/modelViewUrl.
Mentions reading the shapediver-platform-backend skill.
Does NOT route to Geometry Backend or PB+GB workflow skills.

evals.name: route-to-pb-gb-workflow
evals.prompt: I have a ShapeDiver model slug and Platform API access keys. I want to inspect the parameters and then generate an export in a backend script.
evals.expected_output: Routes the user to the combined Platform + Geometry workflow path because the task starts from Platform-side resolution and ends in Geometry runtime work.
assertions: Classifies the task as a combined PB+GB workflow.
Does NOT route directly to shapediver-geometry-backend.
Mentions reading shapediver-platform-geometry-workflows.
Explains that PB resolves credentials before GB runtime execution.
